No criador da Comunidade, os arquivos e: In the Community creator, files and previews are processed in your browser until you choose Submit for review. When you submit, files, the creation name, authorship and license are sent to the Community service and published in a GitHub review. Do not include personal information, credentials or private files in the package.
Quando o envio está habilitado, a verifi: When submission is enabled, abuse prevention uses Cloudflare Turnstile. Cloudflare processes technical connection data for this verification and request limits. The service stores a submission receipt in private storage, without recording your IP in that receipt. Recent tracking links are stored in this browser under miniinfos.community.submissions; clearing this storage removes local history but does not remove files already submitted to GitHub.
Ao enviar um tema ou mascote, informe su: When submitting a theme or pet, provide authorship, credits and a license that allows distribution. Submit only your own content or content you have permission to share. Submission creates a public review and does not guarantee publication. Technical validation and maintainer review take place before inclusion in the catalog; invalid or unauthorized files may be rejected or removed.
